label: High-distress heavy social-media user
summary: This profile is characterized by comparatively higher loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms, alongside heavier daily social-media use.
demographic_anchor: Typically represented by a female respondent with graduate-level education or above and more than 5 hours of daily social-media use.
behavior_markers: Spends a relatively large amount of time on social media each day
tone: Distressed, socially disconnected, and digitally intensive

label: Low-distress light social-media user
summary: This profile reflects respondents with comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms, alongside lighter daily social-media use.
demographic_anchor: Typically male, educated to graduate level or above, and reporting about 1-3 hours of social-media use per day.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively low loneliness compared with other profiles.
Shows low average depressive symptom levels.
Shows very low average anxiety symptom levels.
Uses social media for a lighter amount of time each day.
Daily social-media use centers around roughly 2.8 hours.
tone: Generally stable, low-distress, and moderate in digital engagement.

label: Lonelier heavy social-media user with comparatively lower depression and anxiety
summary: This profile is characterized by relatively higher loneliness alongside comparatively lower depressive and anxiety symptoms, with heavier daily social-media use.
demographic_anchor: Typically female, educated to graduate level or above, and reporting about 3-5 hours of daily social-media use.
behavior_markers: Shows relatively lower average depressive symptoms.
Shows relatively lower average anxiety symptoms.
Spends relatively more time on social media each day, with an average near 4.9 hours.
tone: Socially connected online but emotionally more isolated, with notable social-media engagement and relatively low broader distress symptoms.

label: Low Distress, Light Social-Media Use
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and low anxiety symptoms, alongside lighter daily social-media use.
demographic_anchor: Typically male, educated to graduate level or above, and using social media around 1-3 hours per day.
behavior_markers: Shows low average depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 mean: 0.82)
Shows low average anxiety symptoms (GAD-7 mean: 0.90)
Tends toward lighter daily social-media use (midpoint: 1.61 hours)
tone: Generally stable, low-distress, and moderate in digital engagement.
